description: Fetches structured metadata (caption, likes, comments, date, author) from Instagram media pages (posts, reels, TV) by parsing Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_media_info: Fetches metadata from an Instagram media URL; requires 'url' parameter; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description: Instagram media URL (post, reel, or TV) to fetch metadata from. Used by get_media_info function.
